options.content:
**Monitoring only · America/Chicago · 5-year retention**

Heating and fan activity were verified during a natural cycle on 2026-11-15. Daily heating estimates count only consecutive, observed idle/heating samples; transitions and gaps count as unknown. Cooling runtime, cycle counts, and cycle duration remain unverified and are omitted. Selected HVAC mode is a setting, not proof of operation. Missing activity is unknown, never idle.

Snapshots every 30 seconds do not add Honeywell polls. **HA report age is not the age of a successful cloud update**: TCC can briefly retain cached values during errors and does not expose a last-success timestamp. An unchanged reading is not itself a failure. Unknown/unavailable states are explicit; gaps are never filled with zero. Current cards use only the last 90 seconds. History retains gaps; coarse time windows may hide brief transitions.

No energy or fuel consumption is inferred. Indoor and outdoor temperature/humidity are confirmed exposed by the Sitting Room integration. Outdoor readings are Honeywell-reported sensor readings, not a weather-service substitution.

Daily heating panels calculate **up to the last 31 days of the selected range** to keep queries responsive. Select any historical month for older daily totals. Temperature/history panels retain the full selected range.

panels.title: Observed heating — estimated minutes/day (up to 31 days)
panels.description: Shows up to the last 31 days within the selected range. America/Chicago calendar days, including 23/25-hour DST days. First day expands to midnight; today ends at the last complete 30-second window. Only equal idle/heating states at consecutive sample endpoints count as observed. Transitions, missing samples, unavailable, unknown and unverified cooling/fan-only states count as unknown. Days without coverage have no heating value. This is a conservative polling estimate, not energy use; cached cloud readings can still mask failures.

targets.query:
import "date"
import "timezone"
option location = timezone.location(name: "America/Chicago")
selectedStart = date.truncate(t: v.timeRangeStart, unit: 1d)
stop = date.truncate(t: v.timeRangeStop, unit: 30s)
limitStart = date.truncate(t: date.sub(d: 30d, from: stop), unit: 1d)
start = if selectedStart < limitStart then limitStart else selectedStart
data = from(bucket: "home_history")
  |> range(start: start, stop: stop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "home_state" and r.domain == "sensor" and r.entity_id == "tcc_equipment_activity_code" and r._field == "value")
observed = data
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 30s, location: timezone.utc, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
missing = data
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 30s, location: timezone.utc, fn: count, createEmpty: true)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value == 0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: -1.0}))
samples = union(tables: [observed, missing])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._time > start and r._time <= stop)
  |> group() |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> duplicate(column: "_value", as: "delta")
  |> difference(columns: ["delta"], keepFirst: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: time(v: int(v: r._time) - 1), _start: start, _stop: stop,
      known: if exists r.delta and r.delta == 0.0 and (r._value == 0.0 or r._value == 1.0) then 0.5 else 0.0,
      heat: if exists r.delta and r.delta == 0.0 and r._value == 1.0 then 0.5 else 0.0
  }))
  |> group(columns: ["_start", "_stop"])
heat = samples |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r.heat}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: sum, timeSrc: "_start", createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]) |> rename(columns: {_value: "heat"})
known = samples |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r.known}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: sum, timeSrc: "_start", createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]) |> rename(columns: {_value: "known"})
unknown = samples |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: 0.5 - r.known}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: sum, timeSrc: "_start", createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]) |> rename(columns: {_value: "unknown"})
observedDaily = join(tables: {heat: heat, known: known}, on: ["_time"])
daily = join(tables: {observed: observedDaily, unknown: unknown}, on: ["_time"])

daily |> filter(fn: (r) => r.known > 0.0) |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, "Heating minutes": r.heat}))

panels.title: Unknown / unobserved minutes per day (up to 31 days)
panels.description: Shows up to the last 31 days within the selected range. America/Chicago calendar days, including 23/25-hour DST days. Transitions, missing samples, unavailable, unknown and unverified cooling/fan-only states count as unknown. Days without coverage have no heating value. This is a conservative polling estimate, not energy use; cached cloud readings can still mask failures.
